title: Accounts Assistant
description:
As an Accounts Assistant in Warrington, you will handle day-to-day accounting tasks within the retail business, helping to keep financial records accurate and up to date. You will work as part of the Accounting & Finance department and provide reliable administrative support that helps the team run smoothly.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the retail industry in Warrington.

Description

Key Responsibilities
- Processing invoices: Managing and recording supplier and customer invoices.
- Reconciliation: Balancing accounts by reconciling bank statements and financial transactions.
- Data entry: Inputting financial data into accounting systems, ensuring accuracy.
- Expense claims: Processing employee expense claims and ensuring compliance with company policies.
- Credit control: Assisting with managing outstanding payments and debt collection.
- Making daily payments: Processing payments to suppliers and other creditors, ensuring timely and accurate transfers.
- VAT returns: Assisting in preparing VAT returns and other tax documentation.
- Supporting the Head of Finance: Providing administrative and financial support, including helping with audits, financial analysis, budgeting and forecasting tasks.
- Providing administrative support across payroll, HR and office operations, including maintaining records, supporting business processes and assisting with ad hoc projects and administrative activities as directed by the Head of Finance and General Manager.

Profile
- Experience in an accounts assistant or similar finance role.
- Strong numerical skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage workloads and meet deadlines.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software (e.g., Sage, Xero, QuickBooks).
- Knowledge of accounting principles, financial regulations, credit control and payroll processing.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills with an excellent telephone manner.
- Highly organised with strong multi-tasking skills and ability to work under strict deadlines.
- A proactive, methodical and self-motivated approach to work.
- Accuracy and attention to detail, comfortable working in a busy, fast-paced environment.
- Flexible approach to work, especially during peak periods.
- Willingness to support wider business functions including payroll, HR administration and office operations.
- Ability to build effective working relationships and act as a trusted support to the Head of Finance and wider management team.
- Strong commercial awareness with a confident and determined attitude.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
- Must be able to commute to Birchwood, Warrington.

Job Offer
- Permanent Accounts Assistant position based in Birchwood.
- Salary of £31,000 to £33,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Start anytime between 8am and 9am
- 25 days holidays plus BH

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
Job title : Operations Coordinator, North West

Reports to : Regional Director

Location : Warrington, with regional travel where required

Salary : Up to 28,000 per annum

Hours : 37.5 hours per week

Contract : Temp to Perm / Permanent TBC

Role purpose:

The Operations Coordinator will provide direct operational support to the Regional Director and North West management team.

This is not a traditional administration role. The postholder will become a trusted regional point of contact for managers, colleagues, clients and central support teams. They will maintain accurate controls, coordinate key processes, track actions and make sure commitments move through to completion.

The postholder must operate confidently at regional level, challenge incomplete information professionally and support Area Managers without taking ownership away from them. They must know when to act, when to encourage and when to escalate.

Key responsibilities

Regional operational control
- Maintain the regional action tracker and follow up overdue actions.
- Prepare accurate information for reviews, client meetings, audits and management updates.
- Record owners, deadlines and outcomes from regional meetings.
- Support mobilisations, contract changes, site closures and management handovers.
- Identify repeat process failures and raise risks early.

Payroll, rotas and time and attendance
- Review payroll, WDA and roster information for missing or inconsistent entries.
- Track payroll queries and make sure managers provide supporting evidence.
- Monitor leavers, pay-rate changes, holidays, overtime and temporary cover.
- Maintain issue records and report recurring causes.

Recruitment and onboarding
- Maintain vacancies and candidate activity within Eploy.
- Coordinate interviews, candidate communication, paperwork and feedback.
- Track Right to Work, DBS and other required checks.
- Coordinate new starter forms, access requests and induction arrangements.
- Maintain accurate recruitment and compliance records.

Agency and invoice controls
- Maintain approved agency worker records and required checks.
- Confirm timesheets and SmartTask records support invoiced hours.
- Review assigned Yooz invoices weekly and route queries to the correct owner.
- Challenge missing, conflicting or unsupported information.
- Support month-end clearance of outstanding operational invoices.

Client and colleague contact
- Hold professional client conversations, record feedback and agree clear follow-up actions.
- Complete agreed client and colleague welfare contacts.
- Recognise matters that require management, People or safeguarding escalation.
- Support service-recovery actions and maintain a clear record of commitments.

Uniform, stock and fleet
- Coordinate approved uniform and stock orders and track delivery issues.
- Monitor fleet-inspection completion and maintain vehicle and driver records.
- Escalate unresolved fleet, safety, equipment or asset concerns.

Employee relations and compliance
- Coordinate documents, notes and action records for investigations and formal meetings under management direction.
- Maintain secure case files and track agreed actions and timescales.
- Support audit preparation and close-out actions.
- Escalate welfare, safeguarding or compliance risks immediately.

Systems and reporting

Work confidently across Outlook, Teams, Excel and Word.

Use Eploy, SmartTask, Yooz and regional tracking tools.

Produce clear trackers, summaries and exception reports.

Maintain accurate shared files and provide first-line process guidance to managers.

Essential skills and experience

Experience in operational coordination, facilities management, outsourced services or another fast-moving multi-site environment.

Client-facing experience and the confidence to handle queries, agree actions and represent the business professionally.

Strong written and verbal communication.

Strong Excel skills, including filters, tables, formulas, data checks and trackers.

Confident working knowledge of Outlook, Teams and Word.

Experience with recruitment, workforce, time-and-attendance, finance or case-management systems.

Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines without close supervision.

Confidence working with managers and senior stakeholders.

Ability to challenge constructively when information, process or standards are not right.

Good judgement when handling confidential employee, commercial and client information.

Full UK driving licence and ability to travel across the region when required.

Preferred experience

Facilities management, cleaning or outsourced services.

Payroll, WDA, rota or time-and-attendance processes.

Eploy, SmartTask, Yooz or comparable systems.

Recruitment and onboarding coordination.

Invoice checking or purchase-to-pay administration.

Support for investigations, formal meetings, audits, mobilisations or contract change.

Personal approach

Has presence without ego.

Acts without waiting to be chased.

Communicates clearly and directly.

Can encourage a manager under pressure whilst remaining clear about the required outcome.

Keeps accurate records and closes actions.

Challenges professionally and protects accountability.

Stays calm when priorities compete.

Notices when something does not look right and asks the question.

Wants to learn the FM business and grow within Atlas.

Measures of success

Regional trackers remain accurate and current.

Payroll, WDA, recruitment, onboarding and invoice actions meet agreed deadlines.

Incomplete submissions and repeat process failures reduce.

Client and colleague actions are recorded, owned and completed.

Fleet, uniform, stock, audit and compliance actions remain controlled.

Area Managers receive practical support without losing accountability.

The Regional Director receives clear information and early warning of risk.

Clients and central teams recognise the postholder as a credible regional contact.

title: Corporate Insolvency Administrator
description:
Corporate Insolvency Administrator

Location: Warrington

Working arrangements: 100% office-based

Salary: Dependent on experience

Build your career in corporate insolvency-or bring your IVA experience into a new specialism.

Imperium Financial Recruitment is recruiting a Corporate Insolvency Administrator to join a busy firm of Corporate Insolvency Specialists based in Warrington.

This opportunity is suitable for an experienced Corporate Insolvency Administrator seeking a fresh challenge, or someone with an IVA administration background who would like to transition into corporate insolvency.

Working alongside experienced insolvency professionals, you will help progress a varied corporate caseload and develop your technical knowledge through practical casework. Responsibilities will reflect your existing experience, with guidance as you become familiar with the firm's procedures and case requirements.

This role is fully office-based in Warrington, so applicants must be comfortable attending the office five days a week.

The role

You will support the administration of corporate insolvency appointments, working closely with Insolvency Practitioners, managers and colleagues to progress cases efficiently and maintain accurate records.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Assisting with corporate insolvency cases from appointment through to closure.
- Preparing correspondence, reports, notices and supporting case documentation.
- Liaising with directors, creditors, solicitors, agents and other interested parties.
- Gathering and reviewing company information, financial records and supporting documents.
- Assisting with the identification and realisation of company assets.
- Supporting investigations into company affairs and highlighting matters requiring further review.
- Recording creditor claims and assisting with distributions where appropriate.
- Monitoring deadlines and following up on outstanding information.
- Maintaining accurate case files and updating the case management system.
- Liaising with the cashiering team regarding case receipts and payments.
- Preparing cases for review and assisting with closure procedures.

About you

You will have experience in corporate insolvency administration or IVA administration, together with a clear interest in developing a career in corporate insolvency.

You will also bring:
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail and an accurate approach to documentation.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills.
- Confidence dealing professionally with a range of stakeholders.
- A proactive approach to progressing tasks and resolving queries.
- The ability to work collaboratively and seek guidance when needed.
- A willingness to learn and take on increasing responsibility.

Previous experience of corporate insolvency procedures would be advantageous. A relevant qualification, such as the CPI, would also be beneficial but is not essential.

Moving from an IVA background?

If you currently work in IVA administration and want to broaden your insolvency experience, we would welcome your application.

Your experience of managing cases, monitoring deadlines, preparing documentation and communicating with creditors could provide a useful foundation for the move. You will need a genuine interest in corporate insolvency and the motivation to learn different procedures and technical requirements.

The opportunity
- Join a busy specialist corporate insolvency firm.
- Gain exposure to varied corporate casework.
- Work directly alongside experienced colleagues in an office environment.
- Build your technical knowledge and case management experience.
- Take on greater responsibility as your skills develop.

title: Breakdown & Recovery Co-ordinator
description:
Breakdown & Recovery Co-ordinator

Location: Widnes

Salary: From £13.00 per hour (dependent on shift & experience)

Shift Pattern: 4 days on, 2 days off - 12-hour shifts (day & night shifts available) Alternative shift patterns may be considered and discussed at interview.

Contract: Full-time, Permanent

About Us

Hough Green Garage is a leading provider of 24-hour Breakdown & Recovery Services, proudly operating for over 40 years. We support Local Authorities, Blue Light Emergency Services, major Motoring Organisations, and private companies nationwide. Due to continued growth and new contract awards, we are expanding our Control Centre team in Widnes.

The Role

We are seeking dedicated Breakdown & Recovery Co-ordinators to join our fast-paced 24hour Control Centre. This role requires calm, confident decision-making, especially when dealing with time-critical and emergency situations. You will be managing inbound and outbound calls, deploying recovery operators, and ensuring jobs are completed efficiently and professionally.

You will interact daily with members of the public, emergency services, motoring organisations, and roadside teams.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate and deploy recovery resources efficiently across all active jobs
- Monitor job progress through to completion
- Manage driver workloads and map nearest available resources
- Answer and manage high-volume inbound and outbound calls
- Liaise with administrative staff and recovery teams
- Raise workload issues or operational concerns with management
- Provide training and support to colleagues as required
- Handle customer enquiries professionally in person and by phone
- Ensure accurate documentation and compliant handling of personal data (GDPR)
- Conduct property searches with integrity and confidentiality

What We're Looking For
- Strong communication skills (written & verbal)
- Ability to work under pressure and remain calm in urgent situations
- Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Flexible, proactive, and positive attitude
- Strong interpersonal skills and professionalism
- Target-driven and comfortable working to deadlines
- Understanding of health and safety requirements

Additional Information

- Alternative shift patterns may be considered and discussed at interview.

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Hough Green Garage, please do not hesitate to apply.
